controls.name: reference-channel passthrough
controls.role: Single-channel identity baseline so array gain and target damage are visible rather than attributed to the beamformer.

controls.name: delay-and-sum baseline
controls.role: Classic baseline that must precede MVDR; MVDR mask quality and distortion are compared against it.

controls.name: oracle-mask and oracle-steering upper bound
controls.role: Oracle groups are recorded separately; an oracle-assisted score cannot be pooled with an estimated-mask or estimated-direction score.

controls.name: geometry and calibration mismatch
controls.role: Wrong spacing, swapped channels or biased steering are adverse controls for declared geometry and channel calibration.

controls.name: channel dropout and missing channel
controls.role: Channel loss must be reported as an invalid or degraded condition, not silently replaced by a mono result.

controls.name: target and clean near-end preservation
controls.role: Beamforming gain cannot pass a claim while target speech is damaged; target leakage and target damage are separate metrics.

controls.name: adjacent multichannel WPE control
controls.role: WPE runs are an adjacent dereverberation control with a generated early-reflection target; they are not a beamformer comparison.

controls.name: nonfinite and invalid-output rejection
controls.role: NaN, infinity, channel-count and shape violations fail closed; no invalid output may be scored as a result.
